title: MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Result 2026
intro: Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Result for the Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Laboratory Technician, Field Officer, Occupational Therapist, Inspector (Supply, Weights & Measures), Assistant Engineer, Biomedical Engineer Group 2 Sub Group 3 Post. This recruitment was released for 454 posts. Applications for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 were accepted from October 29, 2025, to November 12, 2025. The written examination was conducted on 29 January 2026 to 06 February 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this Examination can download their MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Result 2026 from the link given below.

MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Result for the Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Laboratory Technician, Field Officer, Occupational Therapist, Inspector (Supply, Weights & Measures), Assistant Engineer, Biomedical Engineer Group 2 Sub Group 3 Post. This recruitment was released for 454 posts. Applications for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 were accepted from October 29, 2025, to November 12, 2025. The written examination was conducted on 29 January 2026 to 06 February 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this Examination can download their MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 October 2025
  • Last Date : 12 November 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 12 November 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 17 November 2025
  • Exam Date : 28 January 2026
  • Admit Card : 22 January 2026
  • Part 2 Exam Date : 29 January 2026 to 06 February 2026
  • Part 2 Admit Card : 28 January 2026
  • Answer Key : 09 February 2026
  • Result : 31 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 250/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges Extra : Rs. 60/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
